## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss a potential project to develop a meal ordering app for a company's canteens in Belgium.](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=0.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [The app aims to solve issues with meal ordering, food waste, and dietary restrictions for \~200 employees across multiple canteens](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=7.0)
  - [Key features: weekly meal selection, notifications, reports for kitchen staff, and simple UI for low-literacy users](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=161.0)
  - [Next steps: Schedule a call with the client to gather more details on current processes and infrastructure](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1374.0)
  - [Potential for future expansion within the company if successful](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1900.0)

## Topics

### Project Overview

  - [Portuguese company with \~200 employees in Belgium](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=360.0)
  - [Canteens serve breakfast, lunch (takeaway), and dinner daily](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=422.0)
  - [Current system is disorganized, leading to issues with wrong orders and food waste](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=420.0)
  - [Budget mentioned: around 2,000 (currency unspecified)](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1858.0)
  - [Potential deadline: prototype/presentation for new canteen opening on June 6th](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1142.0)

### App Requirements

  - [Three user types: admin, kitchen staff, employees](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=571.0)
  - [Three-week rotating menu with daily options](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=585.0)
  - [Weekly meal selection by employees (due by Friday for the following week)](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=660.0)
  - [Notifications to remind employees to make selections](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=660.0)
  - [Reports for kitchen staff on required groceries and meal counts](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=994.0)
  - [Simple UI for potentially low-literacy users](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=965.0)
  - [Ability to move employees between canteens](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=824.0)

### Technical Considerations

  - [Login system with username/password (no email)](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1478.0)
  - [Possible use of QR codes or ID cards for meal pickup](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=711.0)
  - [Push notifications (need to research PWA capabilities)](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=2007.0)
  - [Progressive Web App (PWA) approach suggested](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=158.0)

### Development Approach

  - [Start with MVP: menu creation, ordering, and reporting features](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1261.0)
  - [Consider per-meal pricing model for potential scalability](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=2406.0)
  - [Prepare questions and simplification ideas for client meeting](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1374.0)

## Next Steps

  - [Schedule a call with the client in Belgium to gather more details on current processes and infrastructure](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1374.0)
  - [Prepare specific questions about existing systems and user needs](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=1374.0)
  - [Research push notification solutions for PWAs](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=2007.0)
  - [Discuss potential travel plans for in-person collaboration](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=2294.0)
  - [Begin outlining a project proposal and MVP features](https://fathom.video/share/8nu9_bmNhEzsXbH4XVntwvattrTsYXTf?tab=summary&timestamp=2345.0)
